relationships.subject: TLR9
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that C. rodentium can induce persistent upregulation of bradykinin receptors in colon epithelium in the absence of TLR9

relationships.subject: TLR9
relationships.evidence_quote: However, Bdkrb1 was significantly upregulated in all mice groups following C. rodentium infection, though TLR9 KO group alone showed persistent high expression levels of Bdkrb1 in the recovered phase

relationships.subject: HOE 140
relationships.evidence_quote: a single injection of HOE 140 was sufficient to attenuate visceral hyperalgesia in mice affected by PI-IBS (Figure 7)

relationships.subject: R715
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, R715 also showed an effect on visceral hyperalgesia (Figure 7).

relationships.subject: HOE 140
relationships.evidence_quote: HOE 140, a selective Bdkrb2 antagonist, is clinically used as a pharmaceutical agent for treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema

relationships.subject: B2 Receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: upregulation of the Bdkrb2 gene in the peptide GPCRs pathway is known to be involved in the pathogenesis of visceral hyperalgesia

key_findings: Only TLR9 KO mice developed visceral hyperalgesia after C. rodentium recovery, with persistent colonic epithelial B1 and B2 receptor upregulation.
B1 antagonist R715 and B2 antagonist HOE 140 suppressed visceral hyperalgesia.
